## 11 · Roots — Education: Tianjin → Hong Kong → Bristol (来路——求学：天津 → 香港 → 布里斯托)

https://zhouyixiaoxiao.com/roots/ · https://zhouyixiaoxiao.com/zh/roots/

Tianjin, Hong Kong, Chengdu, Geneva, Bristol: I read maths oar in hand, then took the 3+1 route (three undergraduate years, then a Bristol MSc).

Why it matters: The pieces were there before the PhD: random walks already in the undergraduate thesis, and a habit of speaking up for other students that became the rep work of Chapter 06.

_Fig. 11 — Five cities on one line; the 3+1 arc reaches Bristol a year early._

- Aug 2021 – Jun 2025 · **BSc Mathematics & Applied Mathematics, Tianjin University** (天津大学数学与应用数学本科) — Completed. Joined the School of Mathematics at Tianjin University in 2021, in a mathematics honours class, and read Mathematics and Applied Mathematics until June 2025. Courses included mathematical analysis, advanced algebra, real and complex analysis, and mathematical modelling. Qualified for exemption from the national postgraduate entrance exam. On the site: https://zhouyixiaoxiao.com/roots/#e-education_life-tju-bsc-enrol
- Nov 2022 – Sep 2025 · **The 3+1 route: the first shortcut** (「3+1」：第一条捷径) — Completed. The degree’s last stage ran through the 3+1 route between Tianjin University and the University of Bristol: three years at Tianjin (the third on exchange in Hong Kong), then a one-year MSc at Bristol. Selection came in November 2022; the move was made in September 2024. Because the bachelor’s (to June 2025) and the master’s (from September 2024) overlap, Fig. 11 draws this as a shortcut: the line reaches Bristol a year earlier than it otherwise would. On the site: https://zhouyixiaoxiao.com/roots/#e-education_life-bristol-3plus1-pathway
- Sep 2023 – Jun 2024 · **An exchange year at HKUST (Hong Kong University of Science and Technology)** (在香港科技大学交换一年) — Completed. Spent the 2023–24 academic year as an exchange student at the Hong Kong University of Science and Technology, taking partial differential equations, numerical solution of PDEs and applied statistics. It was where the mathematics turned computational — and where a first neural-network research project began. On the site: https://zhouyixiaoxiao.com/roots/#e-education_life-hkust-exchange
- Sep 2024 – Sep 2025 · **MSc Engineering Mathematics (Distinction, the top UK grade for a master’s), University of Bristol** (布里斯托大学工程数学硕士（Distinction，英国硕士最高等级）) — Completed. Moved to Bristol in September 2024 for the MSc in Engineering Mathematics. Modules included statistical computing and empirical methods; information theory and coding; renewable energy; mathematical modelling in biology, medicine and public health; methods of AI; and skills in mathematical research. It finished with a Distinction and a dissertation on first-passage times of random walks in confined spaces: how long a walker takes to first reach its target (Chapter 01). On the site: https://zhouyixiaoxiao.com/roots/#e-education_life-bristol-msc-start
- Sep 2025 · **MSc awarded with Distinction** (硕士以优异成绩（Distinction）毕业) — Completed. The MSc in Engineering Mathematics at the University of Bristol was awarded with Distinction in 2025. Two months later the same school became the home of the PhD — the walker stayed in the box, and went deeper. On the site: https://zhouyixiaoxiao.com/roots/#r-education_life-msc-distinction
- Jun 2025 · **Graduating from Tianjin University** (天津大学本科毕业) — Graduated. Completed the Tianjin University BSc in Mathematics and Applied Mathematics in June 2025, while already in the final months of the Bristol MSc through the joint route — two degree bars closing within three months of each other. On the site: https://zhouyixiaoxiao.com/roots/#r-education_life-tju-graduation
- 27 May 2025 · **BSc thesis: epidemics in heterogeneous spaces** (本科论文：异质空间中的疾病传播) — Completed. The Tianjin University undergraduate thesis, completed in May 2025, couples lattice random walks with SIR epidemic dynamics to model disease spread in heterogeneous indoor spaces. The 2026 article developed from it proves bounds on the reproduction number, simulates four indoor scenes exactly (office, supermarket, classroom, metro carriage) and confronts the model, under pre-specified protocols, with 38 documented outbreaks, contact records and tracer measurements, reporting where it fails. The random walk was already there before the PhD. Links: [Article (2026): paper, code, data](https://github.com/zhouyi-xiaoxiao/indoor-epidemic-random-walk) On the site: https://zhouyixiaoxiao.com/roots/#r-education_life-tju-undergrad-thesis
- Mar 2025 · **Native Mandarin, English as a working language, beginner French** (普通话是母语，英语是工作语言，法语刚入门) — Completed. Mandarin Chinese is native, English is the working language and French is at A1. In practice the working life is bilingual by default: talks, papers, documentation and websites — this one included — usually ship in English and Chinese at once, and one research paper is about what happens when people type to AI in the space between the two. On the site: https://zhouyixiaoxiao.com/roots/#r-education_life-languages
- 8 Feb 2025 – 17 Feb 2025 · **Geneva: a UN field-exchange programme** (日内瓦：联合国实地交流项目) — Completed. A winter study programme in Geneva built around the UN Office at Geneva, 8–17 February 2025 — the Youth Training Program at the UN run by the World Federation of United Nations Associations (WFUNA), with workshops on humanitarian affairs, multilateralism, diplomacy and the Sustainable Development Goals. In a thirty-person mock UN conference, represented Australia and led the drafting of a fifteen-minute script for a vaccine-cooperation conference; the group visited six international organisations: WIPO, the ILO, the FAO, UNODA, CERN and the IFRC. On the site: https://zhouyixiaoxiao.com/roots/#r-education_life-geneva-un-field-exchange
- Jan 2025 – May 2025 · **What makes a flight late?** (航班为什么会晚点？) — Completed. In a five-person MSc team project with an industry partner in logistics, led the synthesis of more than fifteen causal-inference papers and applied structural causal models to an aviation dataset of about 29,000 points, isolating the effect of weather on delays while controlling for latitude and season. The team combined the causal analysis with Kolmogorov–Arnold networks. On the site: https://zhouyixiaoxiao.com/roots/#r-education_life-causal-logistics-project
- Sep 2024 – Sep 2025 · **Night shifts as a Student Warden** (学生公寓夜间值班) — Completed. Role: Student Warden, University of Bristol accommodation. During the MSc year, worked part-time as a Student Warden in Bristol student accommodation: duty shifts giving residents frontline support and responding to fire alarms under the safety procedures, with fire-warden training completed in December 2024. On the site: https://zhouyixiaoxiao.com/roots/#r-education_life-student-warden
- Jul 2024 – Aug 2024 · **A first press mention, in Chengdu** (第一次见报，在成都) — Completed. During the summer internship programme of 2024, a visit to the Chengdu World Horticultural Expo on 23 July ended up in a local news report that quoted by name. Around it came speeches at the opening and closing ceremonies of the summer programme for university students — a first stage, and a first microphone. Links: [News report (Chinese)](https://static.cdsb.com/micropub/Articles/202407/bdcc0db02c8f048d477d9f8ce896f0ed.html) On the site: https://zhouyixiaoxiao.com/roots/#r-education_life-chengdu-expo-media-speeches
- Jul 2024 – Sep 2024 · **Research intern at JLL Chengdu, a real-estate consultancy** (仲量联行成都研究部实习) — Completed. Role: Research intern, JLL Chengdu, a real-estate consultancy. A research internship in the Chengdu research department of JLL (Jones Lang LaSalle, a global real-estate consultancy) in the summer of 2024, through the Sichuan–Hong Kong summer internship programme, joined while on exchange at HKUST: data-driven market research, collecting and cleaning large retail datasets in Python, and turning them into findings for stakeholders. The programme’s visits — Guang’an, the Sanxingdui Museum, the panda base — made it a month of Sichuan as well as spreadsheets. On the site: https://zhouyixiaoxiao.com/roots/#r-us_ai_internship_career-jll-chengdu-internship-2024
- Nov 2023 – 31 May 2024 · **Physics-informed neural networks for partial differential equations** (用物理信息神经网络解偏微分方程) — Completed. A research project at HKUST from November 2023 to May 2024 used physics-informed neural networks in PyTorch to solve partial differential equations — one-dimensional diffusion, a two-dimensional wave equation and Laplace’s equation in two and three dimensions — comparing uniform and random sampling of the training points. The 22-page report, ‘Using PINN to solve diffusion, wave and Laplace equations’, is dated 31 May 2024. It is the earliest point on the thread from mathematics to AI. Links: [Article (2026): paper, code, data](https://github.com/zhouyi-xiaoxiao/pinn-diffusion-wave-laplace) On the site: https://zhouyixiaoxiao.com/roots/#r-education_life-hkust-pinns-report
- Sep 2023 – May 2024 · **Tianjin University’s booth at HKUST** (在香港科技大学为天大摆展位) — Completed. While on exchange, ran an information booth representing Tianjin University at HKUST, telling visiting students in English and Chinese about research, collaboration and exchange opportunities — an ambassador before the title existed. On the site: https://zhouyixiaoxiao.com/roots/#r-education_life-hkust-booth-promoter
- Sep 2022 – Jun 2023 · **Head of Rights and Welfare, School of Mathematics Student Union** (数学学院学生会权益部部长) — Completed. Led the Rights and Welfare department of the Tianjin University School of Mathematics student union from September 2022 to June 2023, resolving more than forty student issues on dormitories and facilities and organising more than twenty dialogues between students and the university. It was the first time representing other students — and the role came back, three years later, in Bristol. On the site: https://zhouyixiaoxiao.com/roots/#r-education_life-tju-student-union-rights
- Aug 2022 – Sep 2022 · **Guiding more than a hundred new mathematicians** (带一百多名新生入学) — Completed. Led a team of three class guides supporting more than a hundred incoming mathematics students through August and September 2022 — campus tours, answering questions, and acting as the link between new students and staff. A year later, the same instinct produced the maths guide. On the site: https://zhouyixiaoxiao.com/roots/#r-education_life-tju-freshmen-guide
- 2022 · **A certified personal trainer, too** (还是一名持证私教) — Certified. Earned the NSCA Certified Personal Trainer credential in the winter of 2022, out of an interest in training and fitness. It is an unexpected line on a mathematician’s record — and perhaps why the lunch-optimisation post treats complete nutrition as a hard constraint. On the site: https://zhouyixiaoxiao.com/roots/#r-education_life-nsca-cpt
- 2022 · **Outstanding Student Leader Award, Tianjin University** (天津大学优秀学生干部) — Awarded. Named an Outstanding Student Leader of Tianjin University in 2022, for the student-leadership work of the first two years — the thread of service that later reappears in Bristol as a PGR representative. On the site: https://zhouyixiaoxiao.com/roots/#r-education_life-tju-outstanding-cadre
- 24 Dec 2021 · **Darboux’s theorem and Hilbert’s third problem** (达布定理与希尔伯特第三问题) — Completed. Two end-of-term essays for the first-year special-topic courses in analysis and algebra, both dated 24 December 2021: ‘Darboux’s theorem’, seven pages on why a derivative cannot jump, and ‘Hilbert’s third problem’, fifteen pages on whether any two polyhedra of equal volume can be cut into matching pieces. The first long-form mathematics. On the site: https://zhouyixiaoxiao.com/roots/#r-education_life-tju-first-year-essays
- Sep 2021 – Jun 2023 · **Rowing for Tianjin University** (天津大学赛艇队) — Completed. Rowed for the Tianjin University rowing team from September 2021 to June 2023, taking second place in the mixed 2000 m at the 4th Tianjin Water Sports Games and cutting a personal 500 m time by about fifteen per cent over the two years. A physical rhythm under the mathematics: stroke, recover, repeat. On the site: https://zhouyixiaoxiao.com/roots/#r-education_life-tju-rowing
- 2021 · **Beiyang Self-Improvement Award, Tianjin University** (天津大学北洋自强奖) — Awarded. Received Tianjin University’s Beiyang Self-Improvement Award in 2021, as the degree began — a small badge at the very start of the walk. On the site: https://zhouyixiaoxiao.com/roots/#r-education_life-tju-self-improvement-award

## Threads

- **Maths → AI** (从数学到 AI) — The same habit — measure the hidden route — aimed first at random walkers, then at AI agents. Entries: Physics-informed neural networks for partial differential equations (https://zhouyixiaoxiao.com/roots/#r-education_life-hkust-pinns-report); Researcher (Internship) at LiveX AI (https://zhouyixiaoxiao.com/westward/#e-us_ai_internship_career-livex-ai-internship-2025); 46 theorems, checked by machine (https://zhouyixiaoxiao.com/research/#r-research_fpt-dpma-lean); UKAIRS 2026: first-author paper accepted as a poster (https://zhouyixiaoxiao.com/ai/skipping-the-ime/#e-ai_research-ukairs-acceptance).
- **Built for others** (为别人而造) — A guide for the next cohort, a tool for farms, an assistant for colleagues, a library for one tutorial group. Entries: The Tianjin University maths guide (https://zhouyixiaoxiao.com/workshop/#e-projects_code-tju-math-guide); The BioPath platform: map in, traps out, proof attached (https://zhouyixiaoxiao.com/enterprise/#e-projects_code-biopath-platform); Yuexin Cloud AI Assistant — web and desktop (https://zhouyixiaoxiao.com/work/engine-room/#e-company_products-yuexin-chat-launch); An offline, bilingual teaching library (https://zhouyixiaoxiao.com/campus/teaching/#r-school_teaching_service-offline-teaching-library).
- **Bilingual bridge** (双语之桥) — Many projects ship in English and Chinese — including a paper about the space between them. Entries: A public, bilingual research atlas (https://zhouyixiaoxiao.com/research/#r-research_fpt-research-atlas); The UKAIRS paper: prompting AI agents in pinyin (romanised Chinese) (https://zhouyixiaoxiao.com/ai/skipping-the-ime/#r-ai_research-ukairs-submission); A home-built bilingual subtitle pipeline (https://zhouyixiaoxiao.com/media/#e-self_media-bilingual-subtitle-engine); ‘Intelligence. Delivered.’ — print and digital kit for a Madrid trade show (https://zhouyixiaoxiao.com/work/on-stage/#e-company_design_events-wwc-materials-design).
- **On stage** (登台) — From a first press mention in Chengdu to stand-up in Bristol, a PechaKucha (20 slides, 20 seconds each), a 93-minute primer and two trade floors. Entries: A first press mention, in Chengdu (https://zhouyixiaoxiao.com/roots/#r-education_life-chengdu-expo-media-speeches); ‘The Lighter Side of Research’, Bristol: seven minutes of stand-up about a maths PhD (https://zhouyixiaoxiao.com/campus/representing/#e-school_teaching_service-lighter-side-of-research); A PechaKucha (20 slides, 20 seconds each) at the Festival of Enterprise (https://zhouyixiaoxiao.com/enterprise/#e-school_teaching_service-festival-of-enterprise-2026); ‘From SMS to Intelligent Channels’: a 93-minute primer on AI models (https://zhouyixiaoxiao.com/work/on-stage/#e-company_design_events-llm-industry-training-talk).
- **Proof & audit** (证明与审计) — Trust, but verify: computer-checked theorems, 325 million simulated walkers, negative results kept, AI reviewers before every launch. Entries: Programming the number of peaks (https://zhouyixiaoxiao.com/research/#r-research_fpt-fixed-budget-theorem-campaign); A negative result: restoring the Chinese first made it worse (https://zhouyixiaoxiao.com/ai/skipping-the-ime/#r-ai_research-phase3-normalize-backfires); A unified AI access and governance platform (https://zhouyixiaoxiao.com/work/engine-room/#e-company_products-governance-platform-live).
